name: Command Code
note: Quota only. The rolling and weekly caps come from `windowLimits`, which Command Code returns either at the top level or inside a `data` envelope depending on the call — both paths are declared rather than guessed. The monthly credit balance is deliberately not charted: turning it into a percentage needs a plan-id-to-allowance table that only the vendor knows, and an unrecognised plan would produce a confident wrong number.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.
